fixed.change: For scoped principals, search and list_notes add one EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(?) j ...) predicate on the table-qualified n.path. The JS allowed() filter stays as a second check, and list_notes no longer over-fetches.

fixed.change: upsertNotes packs whole notes into batches of about 90 statements. A note that throws while binding, or whose batch fails (retried note by note), is skipped and returned as {path,error}. fullReindex upserts first, then deletes only rows older than the run that it did not skip, plus orphaned links/fts rows. It refuses a tarball with no notes, skips non-canonical paths, and records skips in meta.index_skipped. indexFromGitHub skips and records non-canonical paths and per-file errors instead of aborting the push. The cron still runs hygiene and rollup when the reindex fails. upsertLocal still throws for single writes.

not_fixed.reason: Only partly fixed. index.js now routes all callers (fullReindex, /skills/install.sh) through repoTar(), which passes {maxBytes} (default 64 MiB, overridable with env.TAR_MAX_BYTES) and refuses a tree over the cap. But fetchRepoTar in github.js still buffers the whole decompressed body before returning, so peak memory is not bounded. The variant tarball-scope-cap.mjs (only change: TAR_MAX_BYTES = 8 MiB) shows reindex and install.sh refusing the 16 MiB tree with the cap error, after the 16,781,312 bytes were already buffered. The cap has to live in github.js, which I do not own. Requested change: export async function fetchRepoTar(env, { maxBytes = Infinity } = {}), with a TransformStream between DecompressionStream and Response that counts chunk.byteLength and throws new Error(`repo tarball is ${seen} bytes decompressed, over the ${maxBytes}-byte cap`) once seen > maxBytes. Keep that exact wording so the regexes in test/index.test.mjs still match.

post_merge_actions: Apply the fetchRepoTar maxBytes streaming cap in src/github.js (see not_fixed). Until then the index.js cap only refuses an oversized tree after it has been fully buffered.

Check the real brain repo's decompressed tarball size against the 64 MiB default before deploying. If it is close, set the TAR_MAX_BYTES var in wrangler; otherwise nightly reindex and /skills/install.sh will refuse to run.

Behaviour change: a project:<slug> key no longer receives vault/rules/<slug>.md from get_context unless that rules note has frontmatter 'project: <slug>' or the key has a vault/rules/ scope. Add the project field to the rules notes that project keys should see, or extend expandScopes in auth.js to include the rules path.
Skill files whose names use characters outside [A-Za-z0-9._-] (for example spaces) are no longer installed by /skills/install.sh. Rename any such files in the repo.

Telemetry bounds now apply: 20,000 buffered rows globally (inserts beyond that are dropped and counted in 'dropped'), and 100 R2 objects per rollup run (the next run picks up the remainder). Tune INGEST_BUFFER_CAP and ROLLUP_MAX_GROUPS if real volume is higher.
meta.index_skipped now records notes skipped by the full reindex or webhook indexing. Check it, or the Worker logs ('reindex: skipped' / 'webhook: skipped'), after deploy.
notes: Coordinator's json_each finding was fixed: json_each has a hidden 'path' column, so the scope predicate now always uses a table-qualified n.path (list_notes now uses FROM notes n). The full suite (/target/test/*.test.mjs: app, auth, index, oauth, parse) passes 46/46 in the sbx sandbox.

Smoke check (scratch/smoke.mjs) in sbx: the worker imports; /health returns 200; root tools/list returns 200 with 14 tools; a project:alpha read key can read alpha, gets forbidden on vault/secret/s.md, and list_notes, search and get_context work for it.

Harnesses were copied into agents/fix-index/scratch and run there. None needed protocol-setup changes. verify-04 and hunter3-admin admin_scope_check still fail in setup because createKey refuses scoped admins (group A), so verify04-legacy.mjs from fix-auth was used. Two copies were changed beyond setup, and say so in their headers: reindex-poison-variant.mjs (D1 rejection triggered by a marker value, because parse.js no longer produces the array title) and tarball-scope-cap.mjs (TAR_MAX_BYTES = 8 MiB).

Fake-compatibility tweaks: ingest reads COUNT(*) via .first()?.c rather than first('c'). fullReindex takes its stale-row cutoff from the Worker clock minus 10 minutes rather than asking D1 for datetime('now'). The cost is that a note deleted from git within 10 minutes of a reindex can survive until the next one.

upsertNotes now returns [{path,error}]; existing callers that ignore the return value are unaffected. upsertLocal still throws on failure, so update_note, save and the app.js skills write still report indexing errors.
/admin/reindex now returns {ok, indexed, skipped (first 50)} instead of {ok, indexed}.
Decision rationale is now collapsed to a single line in vault/logs/decisions.md.
No git state was changed and nothing touched the network.
